About this item

  • 【Targeted Support for Neck & Lower Back】 Extended periods of sitting often result in spinal fatigue and muscular discomfort. Riftracer incorporates two adjustable cushions – one for the cervical spine and one for the lumbar region – allowing precise positioning along your natural curvature. Unlike generic foam pads, these cushions adapt to your unique body shape and height. The outcome is a significantly reduced pressure profile, enabling longer, more comfortable work or gaming sessions without cumulative strain.
  • 【52cm Wingless Cushion – Freedom Without Sacrifice】 Many high-back gaming chairs impose rigid side bolsters that confine natural movement. Riftracer replaces this restrictive design with a wingless 51cm-wide seat. The high-density, high-rebound foam core maintains its structural integrity over years of regular use. This generous width permits various sitting postures – conventional, cross-legged, or relaxed – while eliminating pressure points on the hips and thighs. The result is a sofa-like seating experience suitable for a wide range of body types.
  • 【All-Steel Construction – Built to Last】 Durability and stability are non-negotiable for a premium seating solution. Riftracer is constructed with a full steel chassis, an integrated one-piece steel frame, and a reinforced 5-star base. The steel thickness is 3mm greater than industry standard for gaming chairs. Validated through rigorous 150kg (330 lbs) load testing. The fully enclosed caster wheels deliver silent, frictionless movement across all floor surfaces. No squeaking. No wobbling. No distractions.
  • 【Seamless Transition Between Work, Game & Rest】 Adaptability is essential for users who shift between multiple activities. The backrest adjusts smoothly from 95° to 135° with secure locking at any angle. Deploy the retractable footrest to instantly create a resting position. The pneumatic height adjustment provides up to 10cm of range, comfortably accommodating children, teenagers, and adults. Whether engaged in focused work, competitive gaming, or a brief nap, the chair adapts to your needs.
  • 【Straightforward Assembly & Reliable After-Sales Support】 Assembly is simplified with a 5-language illustrated manual and a comprehensive video installation guide. Extra screws and commonly replaced components are included as a precaution against accidental loss. Should any questions or issues arise, our professional customer support team is available 24/7 to provide timely assistance. Backed by a commitment to quality and service.

How customer reviews and ratings work
